title: The Serve (Every Point Starts Here)
style: big band jazz phonk, female lead coach vocal, walking bass, brass groove, half-time backbeat, 92 BPM, call and response, longer than 2 mins, motivational pickleball coaching anthem, choir on final chorus
lyrics:
[INTRO]

(spoken, calm coach voice)

Bounce the ball three times.

Breathe.

Look at the target.

The serve is the only shot you fully own.

[VERSE 1]

Toes behind the line, weight on the back foot

Paddle hand low, ball hand calm

Continental grip, relaxed, not stiff

This is the only ball nobody else is touching

Ball drop or ball toss, choose one and stay loyal

Same routine, same rhythm, every single time

The serve is the moment the rally hasn't started

The serve is yours alone, make it count

[PRE-CHORUS]

Pick the target, see the line

See the ball land before you swing

Three bounces, one breath, one motion

The serve begins inside the mind

[CHORUS]

THE SERVE, EVERY POINT STARTS HERE

THE SERVE, THE ONLY SHOT YOU FULLY OWN

DEEP TO THE BACKHAND, OR DEEP TO THE T

ROUTINE EVERY TIME, RHYTHM EVERY TIME

THE SERVE, EVERY POINT STARTS HERE

YOU CHOOSE THE TONE OF EVERY POINT YOU PLAY

[VERSE 2]

(coach) Where are the toes?

(player) Behind the line!

(coach) What's the grip?

(player) Continental, fine!

(coach) Where's the target?

(player) Deep and low!

(coach) What's the breath?

(player) Slow before I go!

Drop the ball clean, no spin on the way in

Contact below the waist, that's the rule

Brush up and through, full follow through

Aim for the deep corner, make them move back

Push them off the kitchen line, that's the plan

A short serve gets returned with power

A deep serve buys you the third shot position

[CHORUS]

THE SERVE, EVERY POINT STARTS HERE

THE SERVE, THE ONLY SHOT YOU FULLY OWN

DEEP TO THE BACKHAND, OR DEEP TO THE T

ROUTINE EVERY TIME, RHYTHM EVERY TIME

THE SERVE, EVERY POINT STARTS HERE

YOU CHOOSE THE TONE OF EVERY POINT YOU PLAY

[BRIDGE]

(spoken)

The serve is the only shot in pickleball where nobody is rushing you.

No incoming ball.

No reaction time.

Just you, the ball, and a target you chose.

That is a gift.

Most players waste it.

Don't waste it.

Same routine, same breath, same target lane.

Three bounces. Look up. Look down. Swing.

The serve sets the rally.

The rally sets the point.

The point sets the score.

It all starts here.

[VERSE 3]

A low serve skids, they have to bend

A deep serve stretches, gives them less time to send

A slice serve fades, pulls them wide off court

A flat serve drives, lands and stops short

Mix them up, don't show the same look twice

The opponent reads patterns, make the pattern your device

But never sacrifice routine to be tricky

Routine first, variation second, that's the lesson

[PRE-CHORUS]

Same setup, different output

Same breath, different placement

The body trusts the routine

The routine sets up the variation

[FINAL CHORUS]

THE SERVE, EVERY POINT STARTS HERE

THE SERVE, THE ONLY SHOT YOU FULLY OWN

DEEP TO THE BACKHAND, OR DEEP TO THE T

ROUTINE EVERY TIME, RHYTHM EVERY TIME

THE SERVE, THE QUIET MOMENT

THE SERVE, THE CHOSEN TARGET

THE SERVE, EVERY POINT STARTS HERE

YOU CHOOSE THE TONE OF EVERY POINT YOU PLAY

[OUTRO]

(spoken)

Three bounces.

Look up.

Breathe.

Swing.

The serve is yours.

Every time.

Every point.

Starts here.
